Six clues to count

The drops that did not fall.

Name __________________________ Date _______________

All numbers are pretend. Draw, use tens and ones, or show your steps.

1. Little counts 38 dew drops on one leaf and 47 on another. How many drops are there altogether?

38 + 47 = ______Show your thinking.

2. A spider web has 72 dew beads. After sunrise, 38 evaporate. How many beads remain?

72 − 38 = ______Show your thinking.

3. A leaf has 28 drops. Then 17 more form, and later 19 evaporate. How many drops remain?

28 + 17 − 19 = ______Show your thinking.
